propositions: A separately attested plan review must be required at close time to prevent closing after plan or pinned upstream changes without running plan review inside close itself.

The close-time gate must accept code-fresh reviews (signed, registry-current, material-current, phase-compatible) despite HEAD or file-dependency drift, while rejecting unsigned, reopened, stale-registry, own-material drift, or phase incompatibility.

The gate check must run under the existing transaction lock after fresh state/structural checks but before STATUS append, detecting plan/signature/phase/material/pin changes between precheck and lock.

The implementation requires both predecessor stories (75de for PlanValidityProfile.CLOSE and compute_validity; 5967 for signed review phase/floor) and must default to false to preserve existing close behavior.
Existing exemptions (bugs, session logs, code reviews, identities, idea→closed) and non-empty force-close reasons must bypass the plan-review gate while retaining audit trails.
All close failures must use exact verdict-prefixed messages with separate `review-plan` remediation and fail closed on unexpected exceptions without LLM/network calls.
